section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 16, Marma-Älvkarleby
section.notes: Naturkartan and Upplandsstiftelsen give 13 km. The downloaded GPX includes the main stage plus an Älvkarleby station spur; full GPX computes to about 13.403 km and main stage to about 12.599 km.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 16 GPX as primary geometry.
The GPX direction matches official prose: Marma-to-Älvkarleby.
Preserve the official multi-segment geometry. Segments 0-2 form the main route to Älvkarleby Turisten; segment 3 is an Älvkarleby station access spur.
Do not use the final raw GPX point as the Etapp 17 handoff; use the main-route endpoint at Älvkarleby Turisten/parking.
qa: Full GPX has four segments, 191 points and no >500 m intra-segment steps.
The inter-segment gap from the main endpoint to the station spur is about 1296.6 m and should not be auto-connected.
Etapp 15 endpoint to Etapp 16 start is 0 m; Etapp 16 main endpoint to Etapp 17 start is 0 m.

importRows.name: Marmabadet
importRows.notes: Stage-start bathing place at Marmafjärden/Dalälven with jetties and changing hut. Dedupe with Etapp 15 endpoint rows.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Marmabadet
importRows.notes: Rest-area context at the Marmabadet start cluster. Shared with Etapp 15 endpoint rows.

importRows.name: Toalett, Marma badplats
importRows.notes: Toilet at Marma badplats, open 1 May-30 September. Shared with Etapp 15 endpoint rows.

importRows.name: Vatten, Marma badplats
importRows.notes: Drinking water at the Marma badplats toilet/water point, open 1 May-30 September. Shared with Etapp 15 endpoint rows.

importRows.name: Fågeltorn, Storfjärden
importRows.notes: Bird tower about 1 km from Marma, with two platforms and a bench on the upper platform. Use supported attraction type and keep birdwatching in notes.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Ambricka båtstad
importRows.notes: Rest place by Dalälven with long table/benches, matching the official route-text fika pause around Ambricka.

importRows.name: Vindskydd, Gropholmarna
importRows.notes: Shelter/rest area by Dalälven in Gropholmarna nature reserve. Reserve rules apply, including fire only at designated places.

importRows.name: Eldplats, Gropholmarna
importRows.notes: Designated fireplace at the Gropholmarna shelter/rest cluster. Reserve rules prohibit fires outside designated places.

importRows.name: Rastplats, Gropholmarna
importRows.notes: Rest area with shelter, benches and fireplace in Gropholmarna nature reserve.

importRows.name: Toalett, Laxön / Café Furiren
importRows.notes: Toilet at Laxön/Café Furiren during opening hours. Café is seasonal, normally May-September; coordinate/source are strong but availability depends on opening hours. Shared endpoint context with Etapp 17.

importRows.name: Vatten, Laxön / Café Furiren
importRows.notes: Water at Café Furiren/Gröna Källan during opening hours according to Upplandsstiftelsen/Naturkartan object context. Treat as seasonal/opening-dependent, not a guaranteed 24h tap.

importRows.name: Laxön
importRows.notes: Historic Laxön visitor/heritage area with restored late-1800s military buildings beside Älvkarlebyfallen. Keep commercial café/restaurant/hostel details as context unless current opening-hours service rows are modeled.

pending.name: Tältmöjlighet, Gropholmarna
pending.reason: Official route/reserve text says tenting is possible and reserve rules allow at most two consecutive nights, but no dedicated campsite marker was found. Keep pending unless informal tenting rows are supported.

pending.name: Lanforsen
pending.reason: Named scenic route feature in official prose where Dalälven narrows and rushes. Coordinate is route-snapped/contextual; no discrete object page was verified in this pass.

pending.name: Älvkarlebyfallen
pending.reason: Official prose describes Älvkarlebyfallet/Storfallet/Mellanfallet/Kungsådran near Laxön. Import as one scenic route feature only after a stable point source/coordinate is chosen.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Marma
suppressions.notes: Start parking/access metadata only. Shared with Etapp 15.

suppressions.name: Tågstation, Marma
suppressions.notes: Start rail-access metadata only; official route prose says the station is about 500 m east of the start.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Gropholmarna
suppressions.notes: Reserve access parking metadata only; small gravel parking and not plowed in winter.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Tensmyra Norra
suppressions.notes: Reserve access transit metadata only; Gropholmarna page says about 1.2 km walk from the bus stop to the reserve.

suppressions.name: Parkering, Älvkarleby
suppressions.notes: Large endpoint parking by Västanåvägen north of Laxön. Shared with Etapp 17.

suppressions.name: Busshållplats, Älvkarleby Turisten
suppressions.notes: Endpoint bus stop metadata only. Shared with Etapp 17.

suppressions.name: Tågstation, Älvkarleby
suppressions.notes: Rail access metadata only. The GPX includes a separate station spur; do not treat this point as the Etapp 17 handoff.

suppressions.name: Gropholmarna reserve rules
suppressions.notes: Reserve-wide rules/context: dogs leashed, fire only at designated places, do not damage geology/vegetation/wildlife, no riding/motor vehicles, and no tenting more than two consecutive nights. Riverbanks can be steep.

suppressions.name: Laxön seasonal visitor services
suppressions.notes: Route text mentions seasonal café, crafts, restaurant and hostel on Laxön. Keep as context unless commercial service rows with current opening data are maintained.

suppressions.name: Marma skjutfält context
suppressions.notes: Nearby military exercise/shooting-area context only. Obey local signs/barriers and current Försvarsmakten notices if present.

suppressions.name: Fire-risk and fire-ban context
suppressions.notes: Check current fire-risk/fire-ban guidance before using fireplaces. This is dynamic planning context; Gropholmarna also restricts fire to designated places.

suppressions.name: Båtfors nearby reserve context
suppressions.notes: Nearby reserve/hydropower context only; no normal Etapp 16 point imported. If detouring, note that water levels can rise suddenly during power-plant releases.

suppressions.name: Etapp 15 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 15-specific rows except shared Marma endpoint services/access. Do not import Västland, Honolulukojan, Tingshällarna, Trusksjön or the Etapp 15 Marma/Dalälven shelter south of Marma into Etapp 16.

suppressions.name: Etapp 17 leakage
suppressions.notes: Suppress Etapp 17-specific rows except shared Älvkarleby endpoint access/context. Do not import Höghällsberget, Långhäll shelter/fire/campsite or Gästrikeleden continuation into Etapp 16.

decisions.dedupePolicy: Dedupe Marma start services/access with Etapp 15 and Älvkarleby endpoint access/Laxön context with Etapp 17. Keep parking/transit metadata-only. Preserve the Älvkarleby station spur but do not use it as the main route endpoint.

iterationLog.focus: First batch pass for Etapp 16 using official route pages, GPX segment/handoff QA, Naturkartan object pages, reserve/municipal sources, access metadata and leakage review.
iterationLog.result: Created standalone Etapp 16 research file. Normal imports cover Marmabadet/toilet/water, Storfjärden bird tower, Ambricka rest area, Gropholmarna shelter/fire/rest, Laxön toilet/water and Laxön heritage. Gropholmarna tenting, Lanforsen and Älvkarlebyfallen remain pending. Parking/transit, reserve rules, commercial services, fire/shooting/Båtfors context and Etapp 15/17 leakage are metadata-only or suppressed.

validation.mapCanDrawCondition: Draw/use the official Naturkartan Etapp 16 GPX as a four-segment geometry. Preserve the Älvkarleby station spur but use the main endpoint at Älvkarleby Turisten for Etapp 17 handoff.
